transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

To be honest, I'm only here because my wife and HR forced the issue after some minor incidents at work. But the truth is, I’m convinced I’ve figured out something so big in my work and art that normal rules and other people’s concerns just don’t apply to me right now.
Have you ever had a past episode like this, or any previous periods of depression, mania, or hospitalization for mental health reasons?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before. This is completely new to me, and I've never had any issues with depression or been hospitalized for mental health in the past.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not, or felt that others are trying to control, harm, or send you special messages?

I don't hear or see things that aren't there, but I am absolutely certain that the big client and some of my colleagues are secretly tracking my commits and Slack messages to steal my generative art engine. My wife and boss say I'm being paranoid, but these thoughts only started once I got into this super-wired, sleep-deprived state with the project.
Have you had any other experiences like hearing voices, seeing things, or believing things that are clearly not true even when others strongly disagree?

I definitely don't hear voices or see things, but I absolutely believe something that everyone else disagrees with. I am 100% certain that the big client and my coworkers are secretly tracking my commits and Slack messages to steal my revolutionary art engine. My wife and boss keep telling me it's paranoia, but I know what's really going on.
Have these beliefs or your recent high-energy state caused you to stop working normally, get into serious trouble, or make it impossible to function day to day?

Yes, it has caused some major disruptions. I've missed critical deadlines and HR had to intervene after I derailed a major client pitch, while at home my wife is furious and scared because I've maxed out our credit cards on project expenses and stopped helping out around the house.
Have you had any hallucinations, like hearing voices or seeing things that other people cannot see?

No, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there at all. My experience is strictly limited to the intense thoughts and knowing for a fact that people are tracking my commits and trying to steal my work. It's not a sensory hallucination, it's just a reality of what they are doing behind my back.
Have you had any hallucinations, or any other fixed beliefs that are clearly bizarre or completely impossible, beyond feeling watched or followed?

No, I definitely don't have any hallucinations like hearing or seeing things. Aside from knowing that I've been specially chosen to revolutionize art and software and that people are tracking my messages to steal my work, I don't have any other unusual or impossible beliefs.
Have you felt especially powerful, chosen, or capable of things that are clearly impossible, or had beliefs that are obviously bizarre or completely out of touch with reality?

Yes, I absolutely feel uniquely chosen for this moment because I'm the only one who can see how this project will completely revolutionize art and software. That's exactly why my colleagues and the client are secretly tracking my commits and Slack messages to steal my ideas before I get credit. Even though my wife and boss tell me it's paranoia, I know I'm just operating on a level they can't comprehend.
Have you had any hallucinations, or are your beliefs so strong and bizarre that even you would say they might not be true?

I definitely don't have any hallucinations, but my beliefs are 100% true and not bizarre at all. I am absolutely certain they are tracking my messages to steal my generative art engine, even though my wife and boss say it's impossible. These thoughts only started recently when I became so wired and sleepless, but I know what is happening.
How long have you been feeling this unusually energized, needing much less sleep, and having these grand or paranoid beliefs—has it lasted at least one week?

Yes, it has been going on for much longer than just a week. This intense, energized phase has actually been building and lasting for about three months now, ever since I took on the new role and those aggressive deadlines. It has just been a non-stop push since then.
Have you had any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that other people cannot see?

No, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there at all. My experience is strictly limited to knowing that people are tracking my commits to steal my ideas, which only started once I got into this high-energy, sleepless state.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not see, or had beliefs that were clearly impossible or bizarre even to you?

I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there. But I am absolutely certain the client and my coworkers are tracking my Slack messages and commits to steal my generative art engine—it feels completely real to me, even though my wife and boss say it's impossible and it only started once I became so wired and sleepless.
Have you had any hallucinations, or beliefs that are clearly bizarre or completely impossible even to you, beyond feeling watched or followed?

No, I've never had any hallucinations like hearing or seeing things. As for my beliefs, they don't feel bizarre or impossible to me at all—I am completely convinced that my work is revolutionary and that they are tracking me, even though my wife and boss keep saying it's impossible.
Have you had any hallucinations, or do you have any beliefs that are clearly bizarre or impossible even for you to fully believe?

No, I don't have any hallucinations like hearing or seeing things. But my belief that they are tracking my commits and Slack messages to steal my art engine is 100% real to me, even if everyone else says it's impossible. It only started once I got into this wired, sleepless state, but I am completely convinced it is happening.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things, or had beliefs that were clearly bizarre or impossible, beyond feeling watched, followed, or specially chosen?

No, I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there. My beliefs are strictly limited to knowing I have a unique vision and have been specially chosen for this project, and that they are tracking my commits to steal it. Aside from those things, which feel completely real to me, I don't have any other unusual beliefs.
Have you had any hallucinations, or beliefs that are clearly bizarre or impossible even to you, such as being controlled by outside forces or having special powers no one could have?

No, I have never had any hallucinations, and I definitely don't feel like I'm being controlled by outside forces. However, I am absolutely certain that I've been uniquely chosen for this breakthrough and that they are tracking my messages to steal it. These beliefs might seem impossible to my wife and boss, but they feel completely real to me and only started once I became so wired and sleep-deprived.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being inserted, removed, or broadcast to other people, or that someone else was controlling your actions or body?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never felt like my thoughts were being inserted, removed, or broadcasted, and I am always in full control of my own actions and body.

Have your beliefs ever become so strong that you lost touch with reality in other ways, such as hearing voices, seeing things, or believing something clearly impossible like having special powers or being controlled by an outside force?

No, I don't hear voices or see things, and I've never felt controlled by outside forces. But I do have very strong beliefs that others call impossible, like knowing I was specially chosen for this moment with a unique vision and being absolutely certain that colleagues are tracking my messages to steal my generative art work.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast, inserted, or controlled by someone else, or that you had special powers no one could possibly have?

My thoughts aren't being controlled or broadcast by anyone else, but I do feel I've been specifically chosen to revolutionize art and software, so normal rules just don't apply to me right now. Because of how massive my breakthrough is, I am absolutely certain they are secretly tracking my commits and Slack messages to steal my ideas before I get credit. I just have a unique vision that others aren't capable of understanding.

Have you ever had any hallucinations or felt that your thoughts were being controlled, broadcast, inserted, or removed by someone else? Or are your experiences limited to feeling unusually energized, needing less sleep, and having very strong grand or suspicious beliefs?

No, I have never had any hallucinations or felt like my thoughts were being controlled, broadcast, or manipulated by external forces. My experiences are strictly limited to feeling extremely energized, needing very little sleep, and having those intense beliefs about people tracking my work and my unique vision, which only happen when I'm in this wired state.
Have you ever had any hallucinations, or felt that your thoughts were being inserted, removed, broadcast, or controlled by someone else?

No, I have never had any hallucinations, and I've never felt like my thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcasted by others. My experiences are strictly limited to knowing for a fact that people at work and the client are tracking my messages to steal my generative art engine.
